title: Section C SC-15: health.ts reads package.json through a __dirname-relative path at import, so any change of the output layout (compiled dist/, the Phase 27 restructure) makes the import throw and the whole bot fails to start

evidence.note: const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../../package.json'), 'utf-8')) at module load
bot.ts imports startApiServer at the top, so the health module loads with the bot

sibling_sites_checked: grep over the API snapshot for __dirname, readFileSync and process.cwd(): health.ts:15 (this finding); server.ts:165 serves dashboard/dist from process.cwd() (cwd-relative: started from another folder the SPA answers 404 'Dashboard not built', fail-soft, recorded here as hygiene); no other file reads.
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: the failure is loud and at boot (the bot does not start), never a silent wrong state; it matters for the Phase 26/27 restructure.
recommendation: Read the version once through a resolver that walks up to the package.json named crypto-snipe-bot (as rail 22-09 does for the DB path), or inject it at build time; resolve the dashboard dist path from the repo root, not cwd. Phase 27.
